mapper.select: SELECT cart_id, cart_items_id, b.brand_name, b.brand_id, p.product_name, pi.image_url, p.product_id, po.sku, po.price, quantity, ci.product_option_id FROM cart_items ci JOIN product_option po ON ci.product_option_id = po.product_option_id JOIN product p ON p.product_id = po.product_id JOIN product_image pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id JOIN brand b ON b.brand_id = p.brand_id WHERE pi.sort_order = 1 AND cart_id = #{cart_id} ORDER BY b.brand_name, ci.cart_items_id
SELECT CART_ID FROM CART WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{member_id}

insert.foreach: MERGE INTO CART_ITEMS ci USING ( SELECT #{item.product_option_id} PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, #{cart_id} CART_ID, #{item.quantity} QUANTITY FROM dual ) src ON ( ci.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID = src.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID AND ci.CART_ID = src.CART_ID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ci.QUANTITY = ci.QUANTITY + src.QUANTITY WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, CART_ID, QUANTITY ) VALUES ( src.PRODUCT_OPTION_ID, src.CART_ID, src.QUANTITY )

mapper.select: SELECT og.group_name AS option_group_name, ov.option_name AS option_value_name FROM product_option_value pov JOIN option_value ov ON pov.option_value_id = ov.option_value_id JOIN option_group og ON ov.option_group_id = og.option_group_id WHERE pov.product_option_id = #{product_option_id} ORDER BY og.sort_order, ov.sort_order
